title: Have had a screwpull for 14 years!!
text: Have had a screwpull for 14 years!!. My husband and I bought this 14 years ago when we first met.  It is used frequently and it still works as well as it did in the beginning.  There are very few things I can say I have had this long and it works just as well.  I would recommend this to anyone.

product_metadata.title: Screwpull Table Corkscrew, Black
features: Table corkscrew effortlessly prepares wine bottles for serving
2-1/2-inch corkscrew employs excellent leverage to remove even stubborn corks with ease
Handsome black finish; engravable for personalized gift-giving.
Measures approximately 5 by 10 by 1 inches; 5-year limited warranty.
description: Serve up favorite wines in relaxed fashion with help from this sleek table corkscrew. Inspired by a design conceived in the 1700s, the timeless unit's durable 2-1/2-inch screw effortlessly removes all corks--even fragile, aged, and porous corks (both synthetic and natural)--from standard or vintage bottles of wine. Its classic self-pulling mechanism features a heavyweight die-cast metal handle that offers a secure, comfortable grip with a bit of luxurious heft, and it employs excellent leverage to pop corks in one smooth, fluid motion--no more embarrassing hassles or struggling with unwieldy corks. Best of all, the unit's handsome black finish and engravable handle make it a practical, personal, and eye-catching gift for any host, business colleague, or wine connoisseur. Both reliable and attractive, the table corkscrew measures approximately 10 by 5 by 1 inches and carries a five-year limited warranty.
